risk_factor_definitions.label: High churn
risk_factor_definitions.rule: Total lines added + deleted is in the top 10% of files

risk_factor_definitions.label: Frequent changes
risk_factor_definitions.rule: Commit count is in the top 10% of files

risk_factor_definitions.label: Recent churn
risk_factor_definitions.rule: Churn in the last 90 days is above zero and in the top 10% of files

risk_factor_definitions.label: Bug-fix history
risk_factor_definitions.rule: Touched by at least 2 commits classified as likely bug fixes

risk_factor_definitions.label: Concentrated ownership
risk_factor_definitions.rule: At least 10 commits and author HHI >= 0.75 (mostly one author)

risk_factor_definitions.label: Strong coupling
risk_factor_definitions.rule: At least 5 commits and >= 50% of them also change one partner file
